units.source_text: 在叶子痉挛之前，岛村首先看见的是她的脸和她的红色箭翎花纹布和服。

en.t: Before Yoko convulsed, the first things Shimamura saw were her face and her red arrow-feather patterned cloth kimono.

units.source_text: 叶子是仰脸掉落下来的。

en.t: Yoko fell with her face turned upward.

units.source_text: 衣服的下摆掀到一只膝头上。

en.t: The hem of her clothing had flipped up over one knee.

units.source_text: 落到地面时，只有腿肚子痉挛，整个人仍然处在昏迷状态。

en.t: When she hit the ground, only her calf convulsed, and her whole body still seemed unconscious.

units.source_text: 不知为什么，岛村总觉得叶子并没有死。

en.t: For some reason, Shimamura could not bring himself to feel that Yoko was dead.

units.source_text: 她内在的生命在变形，变成另一种东西。

en.t: The life inside her was changing shape, transforming into something else.
